course.title: Vector, Matrix and Ordinary Differential Equation

content.value: Convert the differential equation $2 y ^ { \prime \prime } + 5 y ^ { \prime } - 3 y = 0$ into a system, solve the system, and use the calculated solution to get the solution of the original differential equation.
